name: SFPL School-Year Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help with children's and family programs at branch libraries. Openings listed include Ingleside, Noe Valley and North Beach (Cantonese or Mandarin speakers).
who_can_apply: No minimum age is listed for youth volunteers; if a branch is not on the application form it cannot take volunteers right now.
duration: Ongoing; some roles start late October or early November
deadline_text: Rolling. Some positions start late October or early November 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online volunteer form at https://on.sfpl.org/yva
notes: FOG Readers tutoring takes select volunteers age 15 and up (6 month commitment, needs fingerprinting). The same page lists paid teen jobs: YELL (summer, applications open each March) and the Youth Advisory Board (applications for this year closed Sept 14).
